newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls 3.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls 3.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 3.9 percent year-on-year in January, the national statistics institute ISTAT said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 100.2 (1995=100) in January, with month-on-month employment down 0.6 percent from December.
Hours worked per employee were down 5.4 percent compared to January 1996 after remaining stable year-on-year in December.
Istat said the sectors most affected in December by the fall in employment were transport and communications and financial services. -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2501
